specification.name: Budget and application filings
specification.about: The budget filings, advice letters and applications each program administrator files for a filing cycle, as the engine's Measure and ProgramCost inputs.

version.name: Starting version
version.summary: Generated from what the platform checks today: the engine's Measure and ProgramCost input tables, the columns an upload is refused without, the budget filing rule set and the built-in checks.
version.source: The budgets module's layout (jobfile.py), the pinned engine's field catalog, the budget filing rule set and the built-in checks

files: A .zip of delimited text files, one per table, named after the table
An Excel workbook with a sheet per table
file_format.encoding: UTF-8 (Windows-1252 is read where a file is not UTF-8)
file_format.names: Table and column names are matched without regard to letter case
file_format.column_order: Columns may be in any order
file_format.unknown_columns: A column the table does not have is ignored with a notice
file_format.unknown_files: A file or sheet that is not one of the tables is refused

fields.name: CEInputID
fields.definition: The measure's unique, persistent ID. The key of every output row and the join key to a CET outputs file. Blank or duplicate values stop the run.

fields.name: PrgID
fields.definition: The program the measure belongs to; should equal a PrgID in ProgramCost.csv (a measure whose program has no row there is priced with no program costs, with a warning). Groups measures for the program-cost share and, through the program's PA in ProgramCost.csv, gives CreditedPA.

fields.name: ClaimYearQuarter
fields.definition: The year and quarter when the measure(s) were both installed and paid in e.g. '2023Q1'. Its year and quarter set when savings start and how they are discounted. Must match the pattern or the run stops.

fields.name: Sector
fields.definition: Measure-level sector aligned to the program business plan sectors.

fields.name: DeliveryType
fields.definition: From DEER. Identifies program implementation strategy/method of delivering a measure to a customer (e.g. direct install).

fields.name: BldgType
fields.definition: From DEER. Text codes that identify the building type/use and other parameters specific to that building use. For example, 'Com' = Commercial buildings.

fields.name: AC_Climate_Zone
fields.definition: The geographic area where the installation is completed. The CEC designates micro-climate and ranges from 1 - 16. Use 'System' if a program or measure installation is not specific to an area or city. Required for cost effectiveness calc; Must be compatible with defined values (e.g. '3A'). Previously called E3ClimateZone.

fields.name: AC_Gas_Impact_Profile
fields.definition: Used to profile typical period of use for gas appliances/measures. Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with gas savings (e.g. 'Summer Only', 'Winter Only', 'Annual'). Previously called E3GasSavProfile. In ReCET: A name that matches nothing leaves gas savings unpriced (C4.3); a ...FuelSub... name on a residential measure adds behind-the-meter methane (C3.2).

fields.name: AC_Gas_Target_Sector
fields.definition: Used to determine how gas is purchased by the customer (e.g. 'Residential', 'Commercial', 'Core'). Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with gas savings. Previously called E3GasSector. In ReCET: Selects the gas ACC class (C3.2) and the gas rate schedule (C9); must be one of the three for any measure with gas savings.

fields.name: AC_Elec_Impact_Profile
fields.definition: Identifies the measure electric impact profile shape. Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with electric savings. Previously called E3MeaElecEndUseShape. In ReCET: Must equal a supplied or library profile's end_use_name (the library includes the TOU end uses as 8,760s), or the measure's electricity is not priced (C4.1).

fields.name: AC_Elec_Target_Sector
fields.definition: Identifies the electric sector being targeted by the measure intervention. Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with electric savings. Previously called E3TargetSector. In ReCET: Part of the profile match; selects the retail rate schedule (C9) and the NOx/PM10 factors (C14).

fields.name: MeasAppType
fields.definition: From DEER. The measure application identifies the context for the measure's installation. (e.g. accelerated replacement, new construction or behavioral).

fields.name: MeasCode
fields.definition: PA-specific measure code.

fields.name: MeasDescription
fields.definition: Description of measure; should include enough information to allow understanding of what EE measure(s) are being installed.

fields.name: MeasImpactType
fields.definition: From DEER. Describes how the savings impact was determined (e.g. Deemed-DEER, Deemed-Workpaper, Site-specific calculation, etc.). In ReCET: A value containing FuelSub also marks fuel substitution (C1.5).

fields.name: FuelID
fields.definition: This field references a CEDARS value list used to identify fuel substitution for Deemed measures. FuelID distinguishes exempt and non-exempt Deemed measure packages under the Viable Electric Alternative (VEA) framework established in D.23-04-035. In ReCET: AllElec-New, FuelSub-ToElec and FuelSub-ToGas mark the measure as fuel substitution (Fuel_Sub_Flag, C1.5).

fields.name: MeasureID
fields.definition: The measure's unique ID in the source workpaper.

fields.name: TechGroup
fields.definition: From DEER. All Technology Types in an end use are associated with a high-level Technology Group. For example, in the 'lighting' end use all screw-in lighting technologies, including compact fluorescent lamps (CFLs), light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and incandescent lamps are part of a Technology Group. All hard-wired lighting fixtures are part of a different Technology Group.

fields.name: TechType
fields.definition: From DEER. Technology Type is more specific than Technology Group. For example, a Technology Group can be further classified into individual parts. For example, all screw-in lighting technologies, including compact fluorescent lamps (CFLs), light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and incandescent lamps are included in the same Technology Group.

fields.name: UseCategory
fields.definition: From DEER. Describes the end use of the measure in broad terms (e.g. HVAC, lighting, motors, refrigeration, process).

fields.name: UseSubCategory
fields.definition: From DEER. This is a more specific end use subcategory (e.g. the Lighting UseCategory contains Indoor General, Exit Signs, etc.).

fields.name: WaterUse
fields.definition: Water Energy Calculator water used to calculate water energy savings.

fields.name: PreDesc
fields.definition: Pre-existing measure description. Should include enough information to allow understanding of what the pre-existing measure(s) were.

fields.name: StdDesc
fields.definition: Standard practice or code measure description. Should include enough information to allow understanding of what the standard measure(s) are.

fields.name: SourceDesc
fields.definition: The measure package ID for deemed measures.

fields.name: Version
fields.definition: The version of the work paper or DEER (e.g. 2013 Ex-Ante).

fields.name: NormUnit
fields.definition: Type of normalizing units, or basis of NumUnits or quantity used by the cost effectiveness calculation (e.g. 'Lamp', 'hp', 'tons', 'facility', etc.).

fields.name: NumUnits
fields.definition: Number of units or quantity. NumUnits must work in conjunction with the NormUnit value for the claim. Cross reference NormUnit and NumUnits before interpreting quantities of measures installed.

fields.name: UnitkW1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline kW Impact per Unit. In ReCET: Reported in the kW savings columns (FirstYearNetKW ...) only: pricing is on kWh through the 8,760 shape, which carries the T&D value.

fields.name: UnitkWh1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline kWh Impact per Unit.

fields.name: UnitTherm1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline therm Impact per Unit.

fields.name: UnitkW2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline kW Impact per Unit. Only used for accelerated replacement situations. In ReCET: Reported in the kW savings columns only, as UnitkW1stBaseline.

fields.name: UnitkWh2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline kWh Impact per Unit. Only used for accelerated replacement situations.

fields.name: UnitTherm2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline therm Impact per Unit. Only used for accelerated replacement situations.

fields.name: UnitkWhIOUWater1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline kWh impact per unit due to water savings.

fields.name: UnitkWhIOUWater2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline kWh impact per unit due to water savings. Only used for accelerated replacement situations.

fields.name: UnitMeaCost1stBaseline
fields.definition: This field is the installed measure cost. Incremental Measure Cost or Full Measure Cost for the first baseline period, as appropriate for the MeasAppType and DeliveryType. Incremental measure cost over Code/Std for single baseline measures. Full measure cost for accelerated replacement situations. In ReCET: Also used for the excess-incentive test (C8).

fields.name: UnitMeaCost2ndBaseline
fields.definition: This field is the incremental measure cost over Code/Std for accelerated replacement situations, and is zero in other situations. In ReCET: The measure cost the cost tests count for an early replacement (RUL_Yrs > 0); ignored when RUL_Yrs = 0 (C8).

fields.name: UnitDirectInstallLab
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost in dollars of installation labor. Enter the unit incentive for labor. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field; and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims, and is one of two incentive fields for Direct Install. Only use if a direct install.

fields.name: UnitDirectInstallMat
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost in dollars of installation materials. Enter the unit incentive for materials. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field; and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims, and is one of two incentive fields for Direct Install. Only use if direct install.

fields.name: UnitEndUserRebate
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost of rebates to the end user in dollars. Enter rebate to the customer for each unit of the measure. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field, and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims. Only use if downstream delivery type.

fields.name: UnitIncentiveToOthers
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost in dollars of incentives to others besides the end user. Enter the incentive for others for each unit of measure. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field; and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims. Only use if midstream or upstream delivery type. Input should always be '0' for custom measures.

fields.name: NTG_ID
fields.definition: From DEER. The Ex Ante NTG_ID associated with the NTG values being claimed.

fields.name: NTGRkW
fields.definition: kW-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs. In ReCET: Used only in the kW savings columns.

fields.name: NTGRkWh
fields.definition: kWh-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs.

fields.name: NTGRTherm
fields.definition: Therm-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs.

fields.name: NTGRCost
fields.definition: Cost-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs.

fields.name: EUL_ID
fields.definition: From DEER. Identifier from the EUL table which specifies the estimated useful life of the measure technology.

fields.name: EUL_Yrs
fields.definition: Effective useful life of measure in years. In ReCET: Savings run from the claim quarter in whole quarters, the last one prorated (C2.1); the value is used as filed (0 gives no savings quarters).

fields.name: RUL_ID
fields.definition: From DEER. For dual baseline measures, specifies a row in the EUL table that identifies the remaining useful life of the existing technology.

fields.name: RUL_Yrs
fields.definition: For dual baseline measures, specifies the remaining useful life of pre-existing measure in years. In ReCET: 0 means a single baseline for the whole EUL; a positive value below EUL_Yrs makes the measure an early replacement: 1st-baseline savings until the RUL, 2nd-baseline after (C2.3). A value equal to EUL_Yrs is treated as 0, as CET does (a warning); above it is an error.

fields.name: GSIA_ID
fields.definition: Reference to the Ex Ante Gross Savings and Installation Adjustment table.

fields.name: RealizationRatekW
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor: kW weighted Realization rate for all measures included in this claim record.

fields.name: RealizationRatekWh
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor: kWh weighted Realization rate for all measures included in this claim record.

fields.name: RealizationRateTherm
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor: Therm weighted Realization rate for all measures included in this claim record.

fields.name: InstallationRatekW
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor, generally developed by evaluation studies of prior year programs. kW weighted installation rate for all measures included in the associated claim.

fields.name: InstallationRatekWh
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor, generally developed by evaluation studies of prior year programs. kWh weighted installation rate for all measures included in the associated claim.

fields.name: InstallationRateTherm
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor, generally developed by evaluation studies of prior year programs. Therm weighted installation rate for all measures included in the associated claim.

fields.name: Residential_Flag
fields.definition: The measure was installed in a residential setting.

fields.name: Upstream_Flag
fields.definition: The measure was delivered via an upstream delivery type, i.e. targeted the beginning of the supply chain (e.g. the manufacturer).

fields.name: IOU_AC_Territory
fields.definition: The utility avoided costs being used (PGE, SCE, SCG, SDGE). This field was previously called PA. In ReCET: Selects the ACC utility (C3.1, C3.2), the discount rate (C2.4), the retail rates (C9) and the profile match; any other value stops the run.

fields.name: UnitGasInfraBens
fields.definition: The unit benefits due to gas infrastructure savings.

fields.name: UnitRefrigCosts
fields.definition: The unit cost in dollars for refrigeration.

fields.name: UnitRefrigBens
fields.definition: The unit benefits due to refrigeration savings.

fields.name: UnitMiscCosts
fields.definition: The unit cost in dollars that is not captured in other cost fields.

fields.name: MiscCostsDesc
fields.definition: A description of the miscellaneous costs reported in the UnitMiscCosts field.

fields.name: UnitMiscBens
fields.definition: The unit benefits not captured in other benefit fields.

fields.name: MiscBensDesc
fields.definition: A description of the miscellaneous benefits reported in the UnitMiscBens field.

fields.name: UnitTaxCredits
fields.definition: Inflation Reduction Act tax incentives for energy, per unit. The CET sums UnitTaxCredits with other benefits in the TRC calculation where IRA-eligible measures apply. In ReCET: Summed into the TRC ratio's numerator (TaxCredits); not part of any cost or of TotalSystemBenefit.

fields.name: RateScheduleElec
fields.definition: Field to specify measure-level electric rate schedule, overrides default. Used to differentiate between customer types and system average rates. In ReCET: Not used: the schedule follows IOU_AC_Territory and AC_Elec_Target_Sector (C9).

fields.name: RateScheduleGas
fields.definition: Field to specify measure-level gas rate schedule, overrides default. Used to differentiate between customer types and system average rates. In ReCET: Not used: the schedule follows IOU_AC_Territory and AC_Gas_Target_Sector (C9).

fields.name: CombustionType
fields.definition: Field that determines the rate of emission savings per MMBTU of reduced natural gas usage from gas conservation. Res Furnace is used as a default if there is no user selection. If not applicable or unknown, then leave the field blank. In ReCET: A LookupCode of the combustion table (e.g. Residential Furnaces (<0.3):Uncontrolled) gives the gas NOx rate (C14.3). There is no default: blank or unknown means gas NOx = 0.

fields.name: MeasInflation
fields.definition: CET field to specify measure-level inflation rate, overrides CET default. In ReCET: Used only for early-replacement measures (RUL_Yrs > 0), in GrossMeasCostPV (C8); blank = 0.

fields.name: Comments
fields.definition: Text field for clarifying comments.

fields.name: AC_Elec_Impact_Profile_2nd_Baseline
fields.definition: Identifies the measure electric impact profile shape for the 2nd baseline. Optionally used for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with electric savings. If left blank, AC_Elec_Impact_Profile will be used. In ReCET: Not a CET column. The 2nd-baseline years of an early replacement (0 < RUL_Yrs < EUL_Yrs) are priced on this shape (C4.6).

fields.name: AC_Elec_Impact_Profile_Water
fields.definition: Identifies the measure electric impact profile shape for the water energy savings. Optionally used for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with electric savings. If left blank, AC_Elec_Impact_Profile will be used. In ReCET: Not a CET column. The water energy (UnitkWhIOUWater*) is spread over this shape for both baselines, matched like AC_Elec_Impact_Profile (C4.6).

fields.name: ACCVersion
fields.definition: The ACC version this measure is priced on. Accepts values such as 2024, 2026, as well as values like "2022 ACC", "2024 ACC". Blank, or a file without the column, means the run's "ACC version" setting is used. Measures on different versions are priced in one run, each on its own ACC's avoided costs, run parameters and E3 tables; program costs are then shared over all of them and discounted at the run's version's rates. A supplied ACC file replaces only the run's own version and is not saved for future use.

fields.name: AC_Elec_Impact_Profile_Parent
fields.definition: A NMEC true-up's parent profile: the electric impact profile of the claim the record adjusts. Blank = the record has no parent. In ReCET: Not a CET column. The record is also priced on this profile, with its own ACC, timing and quantities, and the ...Incremental columns are its value as filed less that value (C21); nothing else changes. Matched like AC_Elec_Impact_Profile.

fields.name: AC_Elec_Impact_Profile_Parent_2nd_Baseline
fields.definition: The parent's profile for the 2nd-baseline years of an early replacement. If left blank, AC_Elec_Impact_Profile_Parent will be used. In ReCET: Not a CET column. Used only when AC_Elec_Impact_Profile_Parent is filled in (C21).

fields.name: PrgID
fields.definition: The program the measure belongs to; should equal a PrgID in ProgramCost.csv (a measure whose program has no row there is priced with no program costs, with a warning). Groups measures for the program-cost share and, through the program's PA in ProgramCost.csv, gives CreditedPA.

fields.name: ClaimYearQuarter
fields.definition: The year and quarter when the measure(s) were both installed and paid in e.g. '2023Q1'. Its year and quarter set when savings start and how they are discounted. Must match the pattern or the run stops.

checks.finds: PrgID is not in the program registry.
checks.fix: Use the PrgID of a program in the Programs catalog, or ask for the program to be added first.

checks.finds: The program is not one the filing PA may file: another PA's program, or a statewide program it does not lead.
checks.fix: File only your own programs and the statewide programs you lead.

checks.finds: The year is not a year of the filing's cycle.
checks.fix: Use a year from the cycle's first year to its last.

checks.fields: The program cost fields, OnBillFinancing, NumUnits and the incentive fields
checks.finds: A cost, count or incentive is not a number.
A program has two ProgramCost rows for one year.
checks.fix: Keep one row per program and year.

checks.finds: A program's measures have no ProgramCost row for their year, so they are priced with no program costs.
checks.fix: Add the program's ProgramCost row for that year if it has program costs.

checks.fields: Any column of the filing specification
checks.finds: The table lacks a column of the filing specification, so its rules were not run.
checks.fix: Add the column (it may be blank).

checks.finds: The rule set in force could not be applied to a year's rows, so the version cannot be called valid.
checks.fix: Tell the CPUC's CEDARS support; the file may be fine.

checks.fields: A field whose codes come from a value list made for the specification
checks.finds: The value is not a code of the value list, or not one accepted for the record's year.
checks.fix: Use a code from the value list that is accepted for the year (the list's page shows each code's first and last year).
